s: Din tepillin beshabbatot veyamim tobim ubo b' seipim: shabbatot veyamim tobim — enan zeman tepillin, shenneemar: "vehaya leka leot vego'", yatza shabbatot veyamim tobim shehen atzman ot ben haqqadosh baruk hu leyisrael, shenneemar: "ki ot hi beni vego'". Veim menichan bahem leshem mitzva — ober al "bal tosip", vegam mezalzel leot shel shabbatot veyamim tobim bemah shemmeniach alayv bahen ot acher, vechayyab mita. Abal im en menichan leshem mitzvatan ella letzorek acher — muttar, kegon hammotze tepillin beshabbat munnachim bassadeh — muttar lelobsham ulehaknisan lair derek malbush, kemo sheyyitbaer besiman sha:

Yesh omerim shehaot shel shabbatot veyamim tobim hu chiyyub hammitzvot hatteluyot bahen, ulepikak gam chol hammoed eno zeman tepillin, shehare mitzvot teluyot bo: bepesach — meniat akilat chametz, ubechag — mitzvat yeshiba bassukka. Veyesh omerim shehaot hu issur asiyyat melaka bilbad, lepikak chol hammoed shemmuttar bimlaka min hattora — chayyab bitpillin. Veken nohagin bekol gelilot ellu lahanichan bammoed, ulebarek alehen, ella sheen mebarekin alehem bebet hakkeneset beqol ram kemo bishar yemot hashshana, lehorot sheyyesh bahen qetzat qedushshat haot. Veod, lepi sheyyesh omerim sheen lebarek al tepillin bechol hammoed, laken otan shennahagu lebarek — nahagu lebarek bachashay, kede shello yabo haddabar lemachaloqet, zehu taam minhagenu. Abal mi shemmenichan belo beraka — yapeh hu oseh, ki sepeq berakot lehaqel, uberakot enan meakkebot. Veen lachosh bahanachatan le"bal tosip" ap lehaomerim shechol hammoed eno zeman tepillin, lepi sheeno mekavven bahanachato leshem mitzva vadday, ella missapeq hu menichan. Umittaam zeh en bishmirat yom-tob sheni shel galuyyot mishshum "bal tosip". Vekol shekken sheen lachosh mittaam zeh leissur zilzul haot shel chol hammoed, sheissur zeh gam ken eno ella bemitkavven leshem mitzva:
